L0: A checking procedure for spotting inappropriate copied wording in free-form explanations.
L1: A checking procedure for spotting inappropriate copied wording in free-form explanations. It analyzes free-form explanations or outputs for verbatim carryover of phrasing from few-shot example prompts into agent responses.
L2: A checking procedure for spotting inappropriate copied wording in free-form explanations. It analyzes free-form explanations or outputs for verbatim carryover of phrasing from few-shot example prompts into agent responses. It measures the rate of inappropriate verbatim or copied phrasing as a percentage of free-form explanations, such as 9.6%, and can show a reduced rate such as 1.8%. It applies when few-shot prompts use distinctive answer styles, unusual connective phrases, or worked examples. It records copying even when final tool outputs are correct, so copied surface phrasing is tracked separately from task correctness. It can be repeated after examples are removed or paraphrased to check whether copied phrasing decreased; its failure rate depends on example design, and removing examples can also lower task completion.
